question: After meditating on the yaṃ-seed form, what should be visualized next?
premises: The yaṃ-seed form is meditated upon first.
The next object is the form of breath.
inference: Having meditated on the yaṃ-seed form, one should visualize the form of breath.
plain_english: Having thus meditated on the form of the seed yaṃ, one should visualize the form of breath.
